title: An output states the resolution of the method that produced it
note: D-2026-53 through D-2026-56. Each mutation restores a defect that was real: a marking decided by magnitude instead of by why the number is zero, a floor that says nothing, a threshold compared against a value nothing can resolve, a status allowlist wide enough to admit the claim it forbids, and a claims table that names a rule without matching it. A surviving mutation here means the corresponding test is asserting the shape of the mechanism rather than what it decides. OR17 was added after a GitHub runner failed a test in this spec's own suite: the sign of the Mode-C methane noise is host-dependent, and the test defending that finding had pinned it. The class must not follow the sign.

mutations.name: OR17_the_class_follows_the_sign_of_the_noise
mutations.rationale: D-2026-53a. A classifier that answers differently for +1.48e-03 and -3.86e-01 makes the same cell RESOLVED on one runner and BELOW_RESOLUTION on another -- which is the divergence the class exists to be stable across, and the error the first version of test_the_written_methane_zero_is_the_clip_not_the_model made in its own assertions
